Name: Concessions Obsession Trick-or-Treat Edition (Halloween Spirits Eve Trick or Treating with Movie Theater Candy and Snacks)
Author: MissAnaira
Description: Speak to adult NPC's during the Spirit's Eve festival to go trick-or-treating. You may also buy concessions from Pierre during the festival. Gift preferences and prices are based on the vanilla [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Movie_Theater#Concessions]items[/url]. This mod was specifically made for the Stardew Valley Discord 2024 Spirit's Eve event. I hope you enjoy, and most importantly.. Happy Spirit's Eve!

Downloads.Description: Adds a trick-or-treat mechanic at the Spirit's Eve festival that also uses concessions from the movie theater.
